method.geometry: Counts read from all finished component OBJ files; native LOD0 section counts from successful author receipt.
method.native_bytes: Actual uncooked .uasset file lengths, not resident RAM/VRAM, cooked package size or load time.
method.texture_estimate: All mips down to 1x1; each dimension rounded up to 4x4 blocks, minimum one block. BC1 8 bytes/block for opaque color and ORM; BC3 16 bytes/block for color with nonopaque alpha; BC5 16 bytes/block for normal.
excluded_from_gpu_estimate: Niagara donor texture formats and residency
method.no_runtime_claim: No engine launch, cook, packaged FPS, GPU timing, draw-call measurement or performance ranking was performed.
method.file_size_note: GLB disk bytes include compressed image media; this does not assert Draco/meshopt compressed geometry.
method.shared_accounting: Shared texture/native effects bytes counted once in common; do not multiply by four. Per-model rows exclude common Niagara references.
method.active_recovery_accounting: Active per-model meshes/materials follow final manifest and final native author receipt. Eight superseded console meshes, M_Console and T_Cryo_Console are classified as recovery. Other namespace materials/effects/sequence are retained scene support by final authoring records; no new runtime dependency-registry probe was run.
